_about: Translations for the language switch (tools/i18n.py, shared/i18n/README.md): 'en' is Hebrew to English, 'he' is English to Hebrew. Keys are the page's own text, pieces split by U+001F, numbers as {0}. Filled by the project server and tools/i18n.py translate; fix a wrong one here, then run tools/i18n.py bake.
